name: Platinum Vape | 1g Live Resin Disposable | Super Glue
description: Potent and perfectly balanced, Platinum’s P1 All-In-One Super Glue delivers bold flavor and strong hybrid effects in a ready-to-use device. Each hit blends earthy pine and sweet citrus notes with a smooth finish, followed by a high that strikes the ideal balance—uplifting euphoria up top with calming body relaxation underneath. Pre-charged and disposable, the P1 makes it easy to enjoy premium potency anywhere, anytime.
